svg.title: When Love Grows Cold
svg.desc: A one-minute comic in 5 panels. Panel 1 (Matthew 24:3, 12-13; Mark 13:3): Jesus seated on the hillside, speaking to four disciples seated before Him. Caption: "Jesus sits on the Mount of Olives. Peter, James, John and Andrew ask Him privately what is coming." Jesus says: "And because lawlessness will be increased, the love of many will grow cold." Jesus says: "But the one who endures to the end will be saved." Panel 2 (1 Kings 19:3, 9, 14): A close view of Elijah at the mouth of the cave, alone in a pool of light, sweating with fear. Caption: "At Horeb, Elijah lodges in a cave." Elijah says: "I, even I only, am left." Panel 3 (1 Kings 19:18): Pulled back: Elijah, a dark shape in the foreground, looks out over row after row of people standing upright, all the way to the horizon. Caption: "God's answer." The LORD says: "Yet I will leave seven thousand in Israel, all the knees that have not bowed to Baal." Note: "Drawn: a few dozen of the seven thousand." Panel 4 (Matthew 26:30-32): Night on the Mount of Olives: Jesus speaks to Peter and the disciples. Caption: "Two days later, after the Passover meal." Jesus says: "You will all fall away because of me this night." Jesus says: "But after I am raised up, I will go before you to Galilee." Panel 5 (Matthew 28:16-20): On a Galilean hillside the risen Jesus speaks to His disciples; three worship with hands raised, one stands apart with a question mark over his head. Caption: "In Galilee. Some doubt. Jesus comes to them." Jesus says: "I am with you always, to the end of the age." The point: Jesus told you beforehand that love would grow cold. God still keeps a people for Himself, and Jesus goes ahead of those who stumble. Grieve a friend's cooling faith with hope, and go after them (Romans 11:5; Matthew 26:32).
